```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
import json
from html import escape
from IPython.display import HTML, display

with open("../../content/afsc.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

hero = content.get("hero", {})
map_info = content.get("map", {})
plots = content.get("plots", {})
datasets = content.get("datasets", {})

options = "".join(
    f'<option value="{safe(key)}">{safe(item.get("label"))}</option>'
    for key, item in datasets.items()
)

panels = []
for key, item in datasets.items():
    groups = {}
    for link in item.get("links", []):
        groups.setdefault(link.get("category", "More Information"), []).append(link)
    link_rows = "".join(
        f'<dt>{safe(group)}</dt><dd>' + "<br>".join(
            f'<a href="{safe(link.get("url"))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{safe(link.get("label"))}</a>'
            for link in links
        ) + '</dd>'
        for group, links in groups.items()
    )
    panels.append(f'''
    <div class="afsc-dataset-panel" id="afsc-info-{safe(key)}" {'hidden' if key != 'chlorophyll' else ''}>
      <h2>{safe(item.get('heading'))}</h2>
      <dl class="afsc-details">
        <dt>Summary</dt><dd>{safe(item.get('summary'))}</dd>
        <dt>Source</dt><dd>{safe(item.get('source'))}</dd>
        <dt>Temporal Coverage</dt><dd>{safe(item.get('coverage'))}</dd>
        {link_rows}
      </dl>
    </div>''')

cards = "".join(
    f'<section class="afsc-chart-card" id="dashboard{i}"><div id="chart_div{i}" class="afsc-chart"></div><div id="filter_div{i}" class="afsc-filter"></div></section>'
    for i in range(1, 9)
)

page = f'''
<div class="afsc-page">
  <header class="afsc-hero">
    <span class="afsc-eyebrow">{safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}</span>
    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>
    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>
  </header>
  <div class="afsc-overview">
    <section class="afsc-panel afsc-map-panel">
      <h2>{safe(map_info.get('title'))}</h2>
      <img src="{safe(map_info.get('image'))}" alt="{safe(map_info.get('alt'))}" class="afsc-region-map">
      <label for="datasetSelect">{safe(content.get('selector_label'))}</label>
      <select id="datasetSelect" class="afsc-select">{options}</select>
    </section>
    <section class="afsc-panel afsc-information" aria-live="polite">{''.join(panels)}</section>
  </div>
  <section class="afsc-plots">
    <div class="afsc-section-heading">
      <span class="afsc-section-eyebrow">{safe(plots.get('eyebrow'))}</span>
      <h2>{safe(plots.get('title'))}</h2>
      <p>{safe(plots.get('description'))}</p>
    </div>
    <div id="afsc-chart-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <div class="afsc-dashboard-grid">{cards}</div>
  </section>
</div>'''
display(HTML(page))

# JSON is serialized into a script of type application/json for use by the browser.
settings = {
    "datasets": {key: {"label": value.get("label", key), "units": value.get("units", "")}
                 for key, value in datasets.items()}
}
settings_json = json.dumps(settings, ensure_ascii=False).replace('<', '\\u003c')
display(HTML(f'<script type="application/json" id="afsc-settings">{settings_json}</script>'))
```

```{=html}
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/charts/loader.js"></script>
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jquery-csv/1.0.21/jquery.csv.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  const settings = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('afsc-settings').textContent);
  const datasetFiles = {
    chlorophyll: 'spreadsheets/afsc_chlorophyll.csv',
    sst: 'spreadsheets/afsc_sst.csv',
    wind: 'spreadsheets/afsc_wind.csv'
  };
  // Matches the actual order of the eight regional mean columns in all three CSVs.
  const regions = [
    'Northern Bering Sea (NBS)', 'Southern Bering Sea (SBS)',
    'Western Aleutian Islands (WAI)', 'Central Aleutian Islands (CAI)',
    'Eastern Aleutian Islands (EAI)', 'Western Gulf of Alaska (WGA)',
    'Central Gulf of Alaska (CGA)', 'Eastern Gulf of Alaska (EGA)'
  ];
  let currentDataset = 'chlorophyll';
  let dashboards = [];
  let requestNumber = 0;
  const status = document.getElementById('afsc-chart-status');

  function updateInfo(key) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.afsc-dataset-panel').forEach(panel => {
      panel.hidden = panel.id !== 'afsc-info-' + key;
    });
  }

  function drawRegion(index, table, key) {
    const data = new google.visualization.DataTable();
    data.addColumn('date', 'Date');
    data.addColumn('number', regions[index - 1]);
    table.forEach(row => data.addRow([row[0], row[index]]));
    const dashboard = new google.visualization.Dashboard(document.getElementById('dashboard' + index));
    const filter = new google.visualization.ControlWrapper({
      controlType: 'ChartRangeFilter',
      containerId: 'filter_div' + index,
      options: {
        filterColumnIndex: 0,
        ui: { chartType: 'LineChart', chartOptions: {
          height: 65, chartArea: { width: '82%' }, legend: 'none'
        }}
      }
    });
    const chart = new google.visualization.ChartWrapper({
      chartType: 'ScatterChart',
      containerId: 'chart_div' + index,
      options: {
        height: 285,
        chartArea: { width: '78%', height: '67%' },
        hAxis: { title: 'Date' },
        vAxis: { title: settings.datasets[key].units },
        trendlines: { 0: { type: 'linear', color: '#168C96', lineWidth: 2, opacity: 0.6 } },
        legend: 'none',
        title: 'Mean Monthly ' + settings.datasets[key].label + ' — ' + regions[index - 1],
        titleTextStyle: { color: '#123B5D', fontSize: 14, bold: true }
      }
    });
    dashboard.bind(filter, chart);
    dashboard.draw(data);
    return { dashboard, data };
  }

  async function loadDataset(key) {
    const thisRequest = ++requestNumber;
    status.textContent = 'Loading regional plots…';
    try {
      const response = await fetch(datasetFiles[key]);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
      const rows = $.csv.toArrays(await response.text());
      // Row 0: column names; row 1: units; remaining rows: observations.
      // Only columns 1–8 are regional means; later columns contain SD and counts.
      const observations = rows.slice(2).filter(row => row[0]).map(row => {
        const date = new Date(row[0]);
        if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
        return [date, ...row.slice(1, 9).map(value => {
          const cleaned = String(value ?? '').trim();
          if (!cleaned || cleaned.toLowerCase() === 'nan') return null;
          const number = Number(cleaned);
          return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
        })];
      }).filter(Boolean);
      if (thisRequest !== requestNumber) return;
      if (!observations.length) throw new Error('No valid observations in CSV');
      dashboards = [];
      for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) dashboards.push(drawRegion(i, observations, key));
      status.textContent = '';
    } catch (error) {
      if (thisRequest !== requestNumber) return;
      status.textContent = 'Unable to load charts: ' + error.message;
      console.error('AFSC chart error:', error);
    }
  }

  function init() {
    const selector = document.getElementById('datasetSelect');
    selector.addEventListener('change', () => {
      currentDataset = selector.value;
      updateInfo(currentDataset);
      loadDataset(currentDataset);
    });
    updateInfo(currentDataset);
    loadDataset(currentDataset);
  }

  google.charts.load('current', { packages: ['corechart', 'controls'] });
  google.charts.setOnLoadCallback(init);
  let resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      dashboards.forEach(item => item.dashboard.draw(item.data));
    }, 200);
  });
})();
</script>
```
